challenges.says: The "what" offers all six kinds (including a particular user's policy and a user profile) for each side, but the computer side has only local files, the system settings store, a policy file or scratch space; the rules and step 2 say the per-user kinds are user-side only.

Criterion 4 (rule 84588009124214109370) is about refreshing the view after a view setting changes, which is not part of confirming sources, yet the title, what and why of the story never mention it, so a criterion sits in the story with no stated purpose there.
